ppe.title: Templates of generated PPE texts
ppe.note: A PPE consultant checks each template once: record the yes here with the consultant's file.
ppe.failed: The templates could not be read.

whose.thisCompanyWhat: The yes covers this company's generated texts only.
whose.everyWhat: The yes covers the generated texts of every company, including texts of every company.

ppe.emptyTitle: No template of generated PPE texts
ppe.empty: The declaration and the user information are always here; a PPE garment label shows once it exists.

gate.title: Generated texts stay drafts until a PPE consultant says yes (GATE-PPE-TEXTS)
gate.body: A generated declaration, user information or label warning may leave draft only in the languages and for the companies a yes in force covers. The yes is your decision: record it only when the consultant has checked the template. Withdrawing it stops new texts at once; texts issued before stay issued.

record.title: Record a PPE consultant's yes
record.gateTitle: This opens the issue of generated texts
record.gateBody: From now on, generated texts of this template in these languages may leave draft for the companies you choose. It asks a fresh code from your authenticator app.

field.languagesHint: Language codes, for example it, en, de.
field.checkedByHint: The consultant's name and firm, as on their file.

file.hint: The consultant's signed check: a PDF or a scan (JPEG, PNG).

window.title: Template
window.notFound: This template is not here any more.
window.waiting: No yes in force: generated texts stay drafts

what.DOC: Generated declarations of conformity name this template. A draft in a covered language may leave draft; any other stays a draft and the signed PDF stays the live declaration.
what.USER_INFORMATION: Generated user information names this template. A leaflet in a covered language may leave draft; any other stays a draft and the signed PDF stays the live leaflet.
what.LABEL_WARNING: The label's class warnings (EN 17092) print only in the languages a yes covers; the label checks wait for the others.

window.none: No consultant's yes is recorded for this template yet.

withdraw.hint: Generated texts of this template stop leaving draft at once; texts issued before stay issued.

stepUp.record: Recording a PPE consultant's yes opens the issue of generated texts: confirm it with a fresh code.

notice.recorded: The consultant's yes is recorded for {languages}.
notice.withdrawn: The consultant's yes is withdrawn: new texts of this template stay drafts.
notice.fileFailed: The consultant's file could not be opened. Try again.

held.manage: Only the owner records or withdraws a PPE consultant's yes (compliance.ppeTexts.manage).
held.offline: Offline: changes wait to be sent.
held.company: Your role may not record a yes for this company.
held.everyCompany: Only a role over every company records a yes for every company.
held.languages: Type the languages the consultant checked.
held.languageCodes: Type language codes (it, en, de), at most 20.
held.checkedBy: Type who checked the texts (one line, at most 300 characters).
held.reason: Say why it is withdrawn (at least 3 characters).

problem.cancelled: Nothing was recorded: the code was not given.
problem.conflict: This clashes with what is recorded now. Read the page again.
problem.stale: Someone changed this meanwhile. Read the page again.
problem.failed: This did not work. Try again.
problem.forbidden: Your role may not do this.
problem.signedOut: You were signed out. Sign in again.
problem.notFound: This is not here any more.
problem.unavailable: Nexus could not be reached. Try again.

field.templateKey: This template cannot be approved: choose one from the list.
field.templateVersion: This template's version cannot be approved.
field.languages: Check the languages: ISO codes, each once.
field.fileId: The consultant's file did not arrive: choose it again.
field.companyId: Choose whose texts the yes covers.

refusal.DATABASE: The records refused this: read the page again.

cell.title: Not sold in {market}
cell.notSold: This style is sold in {markets}: {market} asks nothing, and it is never counted as a gap.
cell.everyMarket: This style names no market, so every market is checked.
cell.change: Change where it is sold (the style's Overview)
cell.changeHeld: Where it is sold is changed on the style's Overview (Products › Styles).

labCost.fieldHint: What the lab charged for this result. Only roles with the cost grain see it; it never reaches the floor or a portal.

problem.amount: Type the price as an amount, for example 85,50.
